breakdown.method: Each page scored on the 07-judge rubric over the batch strings it renders (frame only; the approved calibration body, card values, FAQ, brand, language names and English fallback names are out of scope). Scores are for the final text after the 7 judge edits. Batch score = lowest page score (config score_rule).

axes.axis: Accuracy of meaning vs. source (and ar where they diverge)
axes.note: No fact added or dropped in 95 strings; list.lead follows en where ar adds a clause (logged); det.unesco 'bileşenlerinden biri' follows ar. Minus 2: det.nearby.d 'ekleyebileceğiniz' slightly suggests an add-to-route control; nav.dining 'Yeme içme' drops the cafés the source names (the full pair is in the footer).

Controls read as Turkish UI after the edits (İsme göre arayın, Haritada görüntüleyin, oklarla seçin, Politikalar ve kullanım koşulları, Site hakkında, Vahada yolunuzu şaşırmış gibisiniz, kuş uçuşu, yaklaşık değerlerdir). Remaining soft spots: det.nearby.h 'Gününüzü tamamlayın' (faithful image, not idiomatic travel copy), det.fromPlace 'Mekândan fotoğraflar' (not rendered on these pages), 'Çevrim içi mağazalar' (correct TDK form, slightly formal).

El-Ahsa, El-Ahsa Vahası, Arap Körfezi'ndeki, Google Haritalar'da, El-Ahsa'da/'daki byte-identical with U+0027; km'den; circumflex rule applied consistently (tarihî, dinî, resmî, hikâye, mekân); polite plural throughout; P9 sentence case; TM pairs reused verbatim. Minus 1: 'çevrim içi' and 'gezilecek yer' were proposals until this round (now added).
Labels a Turkish visitor recognises (Gezilecek yerler, Konaklama, Yeme içme, Ulaşım, İletişim, Sıkça sorulan sorular). Minus 1: 'Vaha meyveleri' stays as vague as the source (owner queue item).
95 keys, no extra key; {op} and {n} intact; arrows ↗ →, ✓ and … kept; Latin digits; no Markdown, no « », no NBSP, no U+2019; checker RESULT [OK].

rulings.title: Circumflex on common words
rulings.ruling: Common Turkish words carry the circumflex exactly where the TDK Yazım Kılavuzu / sozluk.gov.tr headword has it: the relational -î (tarihî, dinî, resmî) and â/û in words such as hikâye, mekân, dükkân, güzergâh. Nothing else gets one; names stay plain (P4). Applies to every later /tr/ batch.

rulings.title: Attraction / place vocabulary
rulings.ruling: 'attraction(s)' = 'gezilecek yer(ler)' in navigation, breadcrumbs, search and lists (common noun, no apostrophe); 'place' in the sense of a saved or nearby spot = 'yer'; 'place' as a generic search object or venue = 'mekân'. 'Al-Ahsa Attractions' = 'El-Ahsa'da gezilecek yerler'.

rulings.title: Control forms
rulings.ruling: Buttons, links that perform an action and action aria-labels are polite-plural imperatives (-in/-ın/-un/-ün: Paylaşın, Kaydedin, Kapatın, Haritada görüntüleyin, Hata bildirin); section labels, headings, footer links and landmarks are noun phrases (İletişim, Ulaşım, Site hakkında, Ana menü); status lines are passive or participial (Aranıyor…, Kaydedildi ✓, Bağlantı kopyalandı ✓). 'view' on a button = 'görüntüleyin', never bare 'görün' (= appear).

rulings.title: No gezinmek next to gezi
rulings.ruling: Where 'gezi' (trip) appears in the same view, do not use forms of 'gezinmek' (navigate) in visible text; arrow-key hints use 'seçin'. 'Gezinti yolu' stays as the breadcrumb aria-label (screen-reader only).

rulings.title: Header labels and length
rulings.ruling: The Turkish header is placed under the Russian precedent (measured: no label has to be shortened). Labels are shortened only on linguistic grounds. nav.dining 'Yeme içme' (header) / nav.dine 'Restoranlar ve kafeler' (footer) is the fixed pair for one page; 'online' = 'çevrim içi' (TDK, two words), not 'online' or 'çevrimiçi'.

rulings.title: Hasawi as an adjective
rulings.ruling: 'Hasawi X' (الأحسائي) = 'El-Ahsa X' with the common noun in the compound possessive (El-Ahsa mutfağı); no 'Hasavi' form. Proper names that the project keeps with الحساوي follow their own termbase entries.

rulings.title: Legal page link
rulings.ruling: The link to the legal page (privacy, terms of use, disclaimer, cookies, IP, external links) = 'Politikalar ve kullanım koşulları'; never narrowed to 'Gizlilik …'.

rulings.title: Approximation sign
rulings.ruling: A source '~' before a number is written 'yaklaşık' ('yaklaşık {n} km'); units after digits take the apostrophe for suffixes ('1 km'den').
